claims.text: For infrastructure projects under the PPP model, disbursement of funds may begin only after the Appointed Date, or its equivalent, has been declared for the project.
quotes: In case of infrastructure projects under PPP model, disbursement of funds shall begin only after declaration of the Appointed Date or its equivalent, for the project.

claims.text: As an exception, where the concession granting authority mandates non-fund based credit facilities as a pre-requisite for declaring the appointed date, the bank may sanction such facilities, following the Chapter XIV instructions on non-fund based facilities.
quotes: in cases where non-fund based credit facilities may be mandated by the concession granting authority as a pre-requisite for declaration of appointed date, the bank may sanction such credit facilities, in adherence with the instructions on non-fund based facilities as prescribed in Chapter XIV of these Direction.

claims.text: Before disbursing, the bank must also ensure that at least 50 per cent of the land or right of way is available for infrastructure projects under the PPP model.
quotes: A bank shall ensure availability of sufficient land / right of way for all projects before disbursement of funds
For infrastructure projects under PPP model – 50 per cent

claims.text: For all projects, financial closure must have been achieved, and the original DCCO clearly spelt out and documented, before funds are disbursed.
quotes: Financial closure has been achieved and original DCCO is clearly spelt out and documented prior to disbursement of funds.

claims.text: If the concession granting authority changes the Appointed Date before disbursement, the original DCCO must be modified through a supplementary agreement. This is subject to reassessing project viability, and a Techno-Economic Viability study is required where the aggregate exposure of all lenders is ₹100 crore or more.
quotes: the original DCCO documented in the financial closure document shall be modified to reflect any change in the ‘Appointed Date’ by the Concession granting authority prior to disbursement of funds by way of a supplementary agreement
A Techno-Economic Viability (TEV) study shall be required for this purpose for all projects where the aggregate exposure of all lenders is ₹100 crore or more.

claims.text: Once disbursement begins, it must be proportionate to the project's stages of completion and to progress in equity infusion and other sources of finance. The stages of completion are certified by the lender's independent engineer or architect.
quotes: disbursal is proportionate to the stages of completion of the project as also to the progress in equity infusion and other sources of finance
The lender’s independent engineer (LIE) / architect shall certify the stages of completion of the project.

claims.text: These project finance directions do not apply to projects that had already achieved financial closure as on October 1, 2025; the earlier prudential guidelines apply to those projects.
quotes: shall not apply to projects where financial closure has been achieved as on October 1, 2025

claims.text: No. The Reserve Bank of India is not considering any fresh proposals to organise new urban co-operative banks, or to convert co-operative credit societies into urban co-operative banks.
quotes: No fresh proposals for organization of new UCBs or for conversion of co-operative credit societies into UCBs are being considered by Reserve Bank of India.

claims.text: For this purpose, urban co-operative banks means primary co-operative banks as defined under section 5(ccv) read with Section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949.
quotes: Urban Co-operative Banks shall mean Primary Co-operative Banks as defined under section 5(ccv) read with Section 56 of Banking Regulation Act, 1949.

claims.text: If the bank received its approval for a particular digital banking channel, such as mobile banking, before these Directions became applicable, it must ensure compliance with the eligibility criteria in paragraph 7.1(a) to (d) before launching any other digital banking channel.
quotes: If a bank had received approval for a particular digital banking channel (like mobile banking) before the date of applicability of these Directions, it shall ensure compliance to the eligibility criteria as detailed in para 7.1(a) to (d) above before launching any other digital banking channel.

claims.text: Those criteria are CBS implementation with public-facing IT infrastructure able to handle IPv6 traffic, compliance with the minimum regulatory CRAR, the minimum paid-up capital or net worth under the applicable licensing requirement, and adequate financial and technical capabilities, supported by a detailed report.
quotes: a) Implementation of CBS and public facing IT infrastructure being enabled to handle IPv6 traffic.
b) Compliance with minimum regulatory CRAR requirement.
c) Minimum paid up capital/Net worth as per the applicable licensing requirement
d) Availability of adequate financial and technical capabilities for this facility. The applicant bank shall submit detailed report

claims.text: The bank must send a GAICA Report to the Department of Regulation, RBI, through the PRAVAAH portal. The report must be certified by third-party CERT-In empanelled auditors, address the specific requirements of the new proposed channels, and carry the approval of the bank's board. It must be sent within thirty days from the decision to launch the facility.
quotes: the GAICA Report, certified by (third party) CERT-In empanelled auditor(s), addressing the specific requirement for the new proposed channels shall be sent to the Department of Regulation, Reserve Bank of India (through the PRAVAAH portal) with the approval of bank board within thirty days from the decision to launch the facility

claims.text: The process is subject to scrutiny as the supervisors deem fit.
quotes: The process shall be subject to scrutiny as deemed fit by the supervisors.

claims.text: Where the approval was granted under these Directions themselves, the bank can provide all types of digital banking channels.
quotes: Once an approval is granted under these Directions, the bank can provide all types of digital banking channels.

claims.text: The NBFC must implement comprehensive, integrated, enterprise-wide and workflow-based solutions or tools to enhance the effectiveness of the Compliance function.
quotes: The NBFC shall implement comprehensive, integrated, enterprise-wide and workflow-based solutions / tools to enhance the effectiveness of Compliance function.

claims.text: The solution must provide for effective communication and collaboration among all stakeholders, bringing together business, compliance and IT teams and senior management.
quotes: provide for effective communication and collaboration among all the stakeholders (by bringing business, compliance and IT teams, and senior management)

claims.text: It must have processes for identifying, assessing, monitoring and managing compliance requirements.
quotes: have processes for identifying, assessing, monitoring, and managing compliance requirements

claims.text: It must escalate any issues of non-compliance.
quotes: escalate issues of non-compliance, if any

claims.text: It must require recording the approval of the competent authority for deviations or delays in compliance submission.
quotes: require recording approval of competent authority for deviations / delay in compliance submission

claims.text: It must give senior management a unified dashboard view of the compliance position of the NBFC as a whole.
quotes: have a unified dashboard view to senior management on compliance position of the NBFC as a whole

claims.text: These capabilities are a minimum (the list applies "inter alia"), and the NBFC may choose the tools or mechanism it deploys for compliance monitoring and the unified dashboard based on the size and complexity of its operations.
quotes: Such a solution / tool shall, inter alia:
based on the size and complexity of its operations, may decide on the tools / mechanism which it would prefer to deploy for monitoring of compliance and development of the unified dashboard

claims.text: A rural co-operative bank may give a guarantee in favour of another regulated entity for a non-fund based facility extended by that entity.
quotes: the bank may provide a guarantee favouring another RE for a NFB facility extended by the latter

claims.text: Such a guarantee is treated as an exposure of the guaranteeing bank on the obligor on whose behalf it was issued, for all purposes including the calculation of capital adequacy.
quotes: Such guarantee issued by a RE shall be treated as an exposure on the obligor on whose behalf the guarantee has been issued by it, for all purposes including for the calculation of capital adequacy.

claims.text: The exposure of the lender extending the facility against the guarantee is treated as a claim or exposure on the entity providing the counter guarantee.
quotes: The exposure of the RE extending credit facility against a guarantee shall be treated as a claim / exposure on the RE which is providing the counter guarantee.

claims.text: By contrast, the bank must not give a guarantee favouring another regulated entity to enable a fund based credit facility to an obligor unless specifically permitted by RBI, except for credit facilities against guarantees relating to trade transactions.
quotes: not provide a guarantee favouring another RE to enable it to provide any fund based credit facility to an obligor unless specifically permitted by RBI
this clause shall not be applicable in case of credit facilities extended against guarantees pertaining to trade related transactions

claims.text: Yes. A wholly owned subsidiary of a foreign bank may, at its option, dilute the parent's stake to 74 per cent or less and list on stock exchanges in India.
quotes: WOS of foreign banks may, at their option dilute their stake to 74 per cent or less
list on stock exchanges in India

claims.text: The dilution must be in accordance with the extant FDI policy on foreign investment in the banking sector.
quotes: in accordance with the extant FDI policy on foreign investment in banking sector

claims.text: A commercial bank's country risk management processes must require adequate internal controls, including audits or other appropriate oversight mechanisms.
quotes: Country risk management processes employed by a bank shall require adequate internal controls that include audits or other appropriate oversight mechanisms

claims.text: The purpose of these controls is to ensure the integrity of the information senior officials use when overseeing compliance with policies and limits.
quotes: to ensure the integrity of the information used by senior officials in overseeing compliance with policies and limits

claims.text: Country risk exposures must be reviewed by the Board or the Risk Management Committee of the Board.
quotes: The country risk exposures shall be reviewed by the Board or the Risk Management Committee of the Board.

claims.text: That review must cover progress in establishing internal country rating systems, compliance with regulatory and internal limits, stress test results, and exit options for countries in the 'high risk & above' categories.
quotes: The review shall include progress in establishing internal country rating systems, compliance with the regulatory and the internal limits, results of stress tests and the exit options available to the banks in respect of countries belonging to 'high risk & above' categories.

claims.text: Any significant deterioration in a particular country risk or in overall exposure must be reported to the Board or its Risk Management Committee at their next meeting, without waiting for the scheduled review.
quotes: such deterioration shall be reported to the Board or the Risk Management Committee of the Board, as the case may be, in their next meeting, without waiting for the scheduled review.

claims.text: The Country Risk Management policy must be periodically reviewed by the Board or its Risk Management Committee, and it must specify the responsibility and accountability of the various levels for country risk management decisions.
quotes: The policy shall be periodically reviewed by the Board [or the Risk Management Committee of the Board] on the basis of the experience gained.
The policy shall specify the responsibility and accountability of the various levels for the country risk management decisions.

claims.text: Notices of every shareholders' meeting called to approve the draft scheme of amalgamation must be published in newspapers at least once a week for three consecutive weeks.
quotes: The notices of every meeting of the shareholders called for approving the draft scheme of amalgamation shall be published in newspapers at least once a week for three consecutive weeks

claims.text: The notices must appear in not less than two newspapers circulating in the locality or localities where the registered offices of the banks are situated.
quotes: in not less than two newspapers circulating in the locality or localities where the registered offices of the banks are situated

claims.text: One of those newspapers must be in a language commonly understood in the locality or localities.
quotes: one of the newspapers shall be in a language commonly understood in the locality or localities

claims.text: Yes. A standalone primary dealer may open demat accounts with a Depository Participant of NSDL or CDSL, in addition to its accounts with RBI.
quotes: SPDs may open demat accounts with a Depository Participant (DP) of NSDL / CDSL in addition to their accounts with RBI.

claims.text: PDO-Mumbai enables value-free transfer of securities between SGL/CSGL and the dealer's own demat account. This is subject to guidelines issued by RBI's Department of Government and Bank Accounts.
quotes: Value free transfer of securities between SGL / CSGL and own demat account is enabled by PDO-Mumbai subject to guidelines issued by Department of Government and Bank Accounts (DGBA), RBI.

claims.text: A payments bank declaring a dividend must furnish a report of its details to the Department of Supervision of the Reserve Bank within a fortnight of declaring the dividend.
quotes: The report shall be furnished to the Department of Supervision of the Reserve Bank within a fortnight of declaration of dividend.

claims.text: The report must follow the format prescribed in Annex II.
quotes: A bank declaring dividend shall report details thereof as per the format prescribed in Annex II.

claims.text: Where the claimants of a deceased depositor's NRE term deposit are residents, the deposit on maturity is treated as a domestic rupee term deposit.
quotes: In case the claimant(s) of an NRE term deposit account of a deceased depositor are residents, the deposit on maturity shall be treated as a domestic rupee term deposit

claims.text: Interest for the period after maturity is paid at the rate applicable to a domestic term deposit of similar maturity.
quotes: interest shall be paid for the subsequent period at a rate applicable to a domestic term deposit of similar maturity

claims.text: Yes, conditionally: regulated entities of the Reserve Bank that join the Account Aggregator ecosystem as a Financial Information User must also join as a Financial Information Provider, if they hold the specified financial information and fall under the definition of Financial Information Provider.
quotes: regulated entities of the Reserve Bank joining the Account Aggregator ecosystem as Financial Information User shall necessarily join as Financial Information Provider also, if they hold the specified financial information and fall under the definition of Financial Information Provider

claims.text: The stated purpose of this requirement is to ensure efficient and optimum utilisation of the Account Aggregator ecosystem.
quotes: With a view to ensure efficient and optimum utilisation of the Account Aggregator ecosystem

claims.text: Generally no: an urban co-operative bank must submit all returns online, and returns sent as soft copies by email are not accepted (not deemed submitted) unless that format is prescribed.
quotes: The UCB shall submit all the returns through online mode in the formats and in the manner as communicated to them, unless specified otherwise.
or in soft copy format through emails, shall not be accepted (i.e., would not be deemed to have been submitted by the UCB), unless prescribed to be submitted in such format

claims.text: As a contingency, if the online portals are unavailable, the bank may be advised to submit returns by email, but it must re-submit them online as soon as the portal becomes available.
quotes: As a contingency measure, in case of non-availability of online portals, the UCB may be advised to submit the returns through email.
the UCB shall re-submit the return through online mode as soon as the online portal becomes available

claims.text: A corporate or business entity's liability on account of business cards forms part of its total assessed credits for complying with the Regional Rural Banks Concentration Risk Management Directions, 2025.
quotes: The liability of the corporate / business entity on account of business cards shall form part of their total assessed credits for compliance to instructions issued by the Reserve Bank of India (Regional Rural Banks – Concentration Risk Management) Directions, 2025

claims.text: That same liability also forms part of the entity's total assessed credits for complying with the Regional Rural Banks Income Recognition, Asset Classification and Provisioning Directions, 2025, as amended from time to time.
quotes: Reserve Bank of India (Regional Rural Banks – Income Recognition, Asset Classification and Provisioning) Directions, 2025, amended from time to time

claims.text: For corporate credit cards, the liability of the corporate or business entity forms part of its assessed credits, and the responsibilities and liabilities of the corporate and its employees must be clearly specified.
quotes: while issuing corporate credit cards, the responsibilities and liabilities of the corporate and its employees shall be clearly specified. The liability of the corporate / business entity shall form part of its assessed credits.

claims.text: The Board of Directors of a local area bank must take all necessary steps to arrest the deteriorating asset quality in the bank's books.
quotes: The Board of Directors of a bank shall take all necessary steps to arrest the deteriorating asset quality in the books

claims.text: The Board must also focus on improving the bank's credit risk management system.
quotes: focus on improving the credit risk management system

claims.text: Early recognition and resolution of asset quality problems requires the bank to be proactive and to use the Central Repository of Information on Large Credits (CRILC).
quotes: Early recognition of problems in asset quality and resolution requires a bank to be proactive and make use of Central Repository of Information on Large Credits (CRILC).

claims.text: Securities in the AFS and HFT categories must be valued separately, security by security, and the depreciation or appreciation is aggregated to arrive at net depreciation or appreciation for each classification (Government Securities, other approved securities, Shares, Debentures & Bonds, Subsidiaries and/or joint ventures, and others).
quotes: Securities under AFS and HFT categories shall be separately valued security-wise and depreciation / appreciation shall be aggregated for purpose of arriving at net depreciation / appreciation of investments for each classification

claims.text: HFT securities must be marked to market monthly or more often.
quotes: The individual securities in the HFT category shall be marked to market at monthly or at more frequent intervals.

claims.text: AFS securities must be marked to market quarterly or more often.
quotes: The individual securities in the AFS category shall be marked to market at quarterly or at more frequent intervals.

claims.text: The book value of individual HFT and AFS securities does not change after marking to market.
quotes: The book value of individual securities in HFT and AFS shall not undergo any change after marking to market.

claims.text: Any net appreciation is ignored, while any net depreciation must be provided for.
quotes: Net depreciation, if any, shall be provided for. Net appreciation, if any, shall be ignored.

claims.text: Net appreciation in one classification cannot be used to reduce the net depreciation that must be provided for in another classification.
quotes: Net depreciation required to be provided for in any one classification shall not be reduced on account of net appreciation in any other classification.

claims.text: The Senior Management of the NBFC is responsible for implementing the fraud risk management policy approved by the Board.
quotes: The Senior Management shall be responsible for implementation of the fraud risk management policy approved by the Board of the Applicable NBFC.

claims.text: Senior Management must also place a periodic review of incidents of fraud before the Board or the Audit Committee of the Board, as appropriate.
quotes: The Senior Management of the Applicable NBFC shall also place a periodic review of incidents of fraud before Board / Audit Committee of Board (ACB), as appropriate.

claims.text: A regional rural bank must, in respect of all business transacted by it, prepare a balance sheet and profit and loss account as on the last working day of the year or the period, in the Forms set out in the Third Schedule of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949, as required by Section 29 of that Act.
quotes: In terms of the provisions of Section 29 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 (BR Act, 1949), a bank shall in respect of all business transacted by it prepare a balance sheet and profit and loss account as on the last working day of the year or the period, as the case may be, in the Forms set out in the Third Schedule of the BR Act, 1949.
These Directions shall be applicable to all Regional Rural Banks

claims.text: These Forms were specified by the Government of India under Section 29(4) of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 through notification S.O.240(E) dated March 26, 1992, and are reproduced in Annex I to the Directions.
quotes: In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 29(4) of the BR Act, 1949, the Government of India has specified the Forms in the Third Schedule, vide notification S.O.240(E) dated March 26, 1992
These are reproduced in Annex I to these Directions.

claims.text: The profit and loss account format is Form B under the Third Schedule.
quotes: the format of the profit and loss accounts of a bank prescribed in Form B under Third Schedule to the BR Act, 1949

claims.text: The bank must also follow the general instructions for compiling the balance sheet and profit and loss account, and must strictly comply with the Accounting Standards notified under the Companies (Accounting Standards) Rules, 2021, subject to RBI Directions and Guidelines.
quotes: A bank shall follow the general instructions for the compilation of balance sheet and profit and loss account

A bank shall ensure strict compliance with the Accounting Standards notified under the Companies (Accounting Standards) Rules, 2021, as amended from time to time, subject to Directions / Guidelines issued by the RBI.

claims.text: As a general rule, an NBFC in the Base Layer must take dividend income on shares of corporate bodies and units of mutual funds into account on a cash basis.
quotes: Income from dividend on shares of corporate bodies and units of mutual funds shall be taken into account on cash basis.

claims.text: Dividend income on shares of corporate bodies may instead be recognised on an accrual basis when the corporate body has declared the dividend at its annual general meeting and the NBFC's right to receive payment has been established.
quotes: the income from dividend on shares of corporate bodies shall be taken into account on accrual basis when such dividend has been declared by the corporate body in its annual general meeting and the NBFC’s right to receive payment is established.

claims.text: Where a company has obtained a specific advice from RBI that it is not required to hold a Certificate of Registration, the auditor must include a statement that the company is complying with the conditions stipulated by RBI.
quotes: where a company has obtained a specific advice from RBI that it is not required to hold a CoR from RBI, the auditor shall include a statement that the company is complying with the conditions as stipulated by RBI

claims.text: This statement is in addition to the matters set out in Paragraph 6(1), under which the auditor examines whether a company engaged in the business of a non-banking financial institution has obtained a Certificate of Registration from RBI.
quotes: Apart from the matters enumerated in Paragraph 6(1) above
the auditor of the NBFC shall examine whether the company has obtained a CoR from RBI

claims.text: A commercial bank must follow a 'secure by design' approach in developing digital payment products and services, making digital payment applications inherently more secure by embedding security within their development lifecycle.
quotes: The bank shall follow a ‘secure by design’ approach in the development of digital payment products and services.
ensure that digital payment applications are inherently more secure by embedding security within their development lifecycle

claims.text: The bank must explicitly define security objectives, including protection of customer information/data, across the requirements gathering, designing, development, testing (including source code review), implementation, maintenance and monitoring, and decommissioning phases of digital payment applications.
quotes: The bank shall explicitly define security objectives (including protection of customer information / data) during
requirements gathering
designing
development
testing including source code review
implementation, maintenance, and monitoring
decommissioning phases of the digital payment applications

claims.text: The bank must implement a multi-tier application architecture that segregates the application, database and presentation layers in its digital payment products and services.
quotes: The bank shall implement multi-tier application architecture, segregating application, database and presentation layer in the digital payment products and services.

claims.text: The bank's Board-approved policy for digital payment products must cover assurance that the payment product is built securely and rolled out after the testing needed to achieve the desired Functionality, Security and Performance.
quotes: formulate a policy for digital payment products and services with the approval of its Board
assurance that the payment product is built in a secure manner offering robust performance ensuring safety, consistency, and rolled out after necessary testing for achieving desired FSP

claims.text: The policy must also require each digital payment product to provide for User Acceptance Tests in multiple stages before roll-out and sign-off from multiple stakeholders after those tests.
quotes: mechanism for carrying out User Acceptance Tests (UAT) in multiple stages before roll-out, sign off from multiple stakeholders [post User Acceptance Tests (UAT)]

claims.text: When a stressed loan is transferred to an ARC at a price below the net book value at the time of transfer, the bank must debit the shortfall to the profit and loss account for the year in which the transfer took place.
quotes: When the stressed loan is transferred to ARC at a price below the NBV at the time of transfer, bank shall debit the shortfall to the profit and loss account for the year in which the transfer has taken place.

claims.text: The bank is permitted to use countercyclical or floating provisions to meet any such shortfall.
quotes: A bank is permitted to use countercyclical or floating provisions for meeting any shortfall on transfer of stressed loan when the transfer is at a price below the NBV.

claims.text: Yes. A small finance bank must report to credit information companies the details of guarantors who have failed to honour their commitments when the guarantee is invoked, as large defaulters or wilful defaulters, as the case may be.
quotes: A bank shall report to credit information companies the details of guarantors who have failed to honour the commitments thereunder when invoked, as large defaulters / wilful defaulters, as the case may be.

claims.text: The details of such guarantors must be reported as per Annex I and II.
quotes: The details shall be reported as per Annex I and II.

claims.text: A guarantor who refuses to comply with the bank's demand is also to be considered for classification as a wilful defaulter, following the mechanism in Paragraphs 5 and 6.
quotes: In case the said guarantor refuses to comply with the demand made by the bank, such guarantor shall also be considered for classification as a wilful defaulter by following the mechanism as set out in Paragraphs 5 and 6.

claims.text: The reporting bank is responsible for reporting correct information and for ensuring the accuracy of facts and figures.
quotes: The responsibility for reporting correct information and also ensuring the accuracy of facts and figures rests with the reporting bank.

claims.text: For the first 5 per cent of the book value of the loans securitised, the originator must hold the MRR through the first loss facility, if available.
quotes: Up to 5 per cent of the book value of loans being securitised:
First loss facility, if available;

claims.text: If no first loss facility is available, or the entire first loss facility comes to less than 5 per cent, the balance must be held by retaining the equity tranche.
quotes: If first loss facility is not available, or where retention of the entire first loss facility amounts to less than 5 per cent, balance through retention of equity tranche;

claims.text: If the first loss facility and equity tranche together come to less than 5 per cent, the balance must be held pari passu in the remaining tranches sold to investors.
quotes: Where retention of the entire first loss facility, if available, and equity tranche amounts to less than 5 per cent, balance pari passu in remaining tranches sold to investors.

claims.text: Retention above 5 per cent of the book value may be held in the first loss facility, the equity tranche or any other tranche sold to investors, in any combination.
quotes: Greater than 5 per cent of the book value of loans being securitised:
First loss facility, or equity tranche or any other tranche sold to investors, in any combination thereof.

claims.text: Overcollateralisation does not count as part of the first loss facility for this purpose.
quotes: first loss facility for this purpose shall not include overcollateralization available, if any.

claims.text: Investment in the Interest Only Strip representing the Excess Interest Spread or Future Margin Income does not count towards the MRR.
quotes: Investment in the Interest Only Strip representing the Excess Interest Spread/ Future Margin Income, whether or not subordinated, will not be counted towards the MRR.

claims.text: The originating bank must hold the MRR itself, not through any of its group entities, and the form of the MRR must not change during the life of the securitisation.
quotes: MRR has to be maintained by the originating bank itself and not by any of its group entities. The form of MRR should not change during the life of securitisation.

claims.text: The MRR must not be reduced by hedging the credit risk, or by selling or encumbering the retained interest.
quotes: MRR should not be reduced either through hedging of credit risk or selling or encumbering the retained interest.

claims.text: The MRR, as a percentage of unamortised principal, must be kept on an ongoing basis. The only reductions allowed are those from repayment or from absorbing losses.
quotes: The MRR as a percentage of unamortised principal should be maintained on an ongoing basis except for reduction of retained exposure due to repayment or through the absorption of losses.

claims.text: For securitisations with a replenishment period, the MRR must be maintained both at initiation and at the end of the replenishment period.
quotes: MRR should be maintained not only at the initiation of the securitisation but also at the end of the replenishment period.

claims.text: The bank must ensure there is proper documentation, in accordance with law, for complying with the MRR.
quotes: bank should ensure that proper documentation in accordance with law is made.

claims.text: In addition to directly notifying customers, the UCB must publicise the benefits of the nomination facility through various media, including periodical drives aimed at full coverage of all eligible customer accounts.
quotes: in addition to directly notifying the customers, shall publicise the benefits of using the nomination facility through various media, including launching periodical drives towards achieving a full coverage of all eligible customer accounts

claims.text: The UCB must give wide publicity and guidance on the benefits of nomination to deposit account holders, locker hirers and depositors of articles in safe custody; this may include printing messages on cheque books, passbooks and other customer literature and launching periodical awareness drives.
quotes: A UCB shall give wide publicity and provide guidance to deposit account holders, locker hirers and depositors of articles in safe custody on the benefits of the nomination facility.
printing compatible messages on cheque book, passbook and other literature reaching the customers as well as launching periodical awareness drives

claims.text: Forms for opening deposit accounts, hiring lockers and depositing articles in safe custody must contain a space for nomination details, which also educates customers that the facility is available.
quotes: contains a space for getting the details of nomination, which also serves the purpose of educating the customers about availability of such facility

claims.text: At account opening, the UCB must explicitly inform prospective customers of the availability and purpose of nomination, offer the option, and clearly explain its advantages, such as a simpler claim process and smooth transfer of funds to the nominee.
quotes: shall explicitly inform the prospective customer of the availability and purpose of the nomination facility and offer her / him the option to avail the same
simplification of the claim process in the event of the account holder’s demise and facilitation of smooth and prompt transfer of funds to the nominee without legal complications

claims.text: The UCB must sensitise its frontline branch staff on obtaining nominations.
quotes: The UCB shall suitably sensitise its frontline staff in the branches for obtaining nomination

claims.text: A small finance bank must provide its internal audit department with appropriate resources and staff to achieve its objectives under the risk-based internal audit system.
quotes: The bank shall provide appropriate resources and staff to the IAD to achieve its objectives under the RBIA system.

claims.text: The bank must ensure that its internal audit function has the requisite skills to audit all areas of the bank.
quotes: The bank shall ensure that its Internal Audit function has the requisite skills to audit all areas of the bank.

claims.text: Internal auditors should be trained periodically so they understand the bank's business activities, operating procedures, risk management and control systems, and MIS.
quotes: They should also be trained periodically to enable them to understand the bank’s business activities, operating procedures, risk management and control systems, and Management Information System (MIS).

claims.text: The internal audit department should be given an appropriate standing within the bank to carry out its assignments.
quotes: should be given an appropriate standing within a bank to carry out its assignments

claims.text: The internal audit function should be kept informed of all developments, including the introduction of new products, changes in reporting lines, and changes in accounting practices or policies.
quotes: The Internal Audit function should be kept informed of all developments, including introduction of new products, changes in reporting lines, and changes in accounting practices / policies.

claims.text: A commercial bank must invoke a default loss guarantee within a maximum overdue period of 120 days, unless the borrower makes good the loan dues before that.
quotes: A bank shall invoke DLG within a maximum overdue period of 120 days, unless the loan dues are made good by the borrower before that.

claims.text: The DLG agreement must remain in force for a period not less than the longest tenor of the loan in the underlying loan portfolio.
quotes: The period for which the DLG agreement remains in force shall not be less than the longest tenor of the loan in the underlying loan portfolio.

claims.text: The contract between the bank and the DLG provider must specify the timeline for DLG invocation.
quotes: Timeline for DLG invocation.

claims.text: A UCB must maintain an up-to-date information asset inventory register, and the fields listed are a minimum requirement.
quotes: The UCB shall maintain an up-to-date information asset inventory register containing the following fields, as a minimum:

claims.text: The register must contain details of the information asset, such as hardware, software, network devices, key personnel and services.
quotes: details of the information asset (such as hardware / software / network devices, key personnel, services)

claims.text: The register must contain details of the systems where customer data are stored.
quotes: details of systems where customer data are stored

claims.text: The register must contain the associated business applications, if any.
quotes: associated business applications, if any

claims.text: The register must record the criticality of the systems, for example high, medium or low.

if such QCCP is classified as a related party.

claims.text: HFT securities must be marked to market monthly or more often.
quotes: The individual securities in the HFT category shall be marked to market at monthly or at more frequent intervals.

claims.text: AFS securities must be marked to market quarterly or more often.
quotes: The individual securities in the AFS category shall be marked to market at quarterly or at more frequent intervals.

claims.text: The book value of individual HFT and AFS securities does not change after marking to market.
quotes: The book value of individual securities in HFT and AFS shall not undergo any change after marking to market.

claims.text: Any net appreciation is ignored, while any net depreciation must be provided for.
quotes: Net depreciation, if any, shall be provided for. Net appreciation, if any, shall be ignored.

claims.text: Net appreciation in one classification cannot be used to reduce the net depreciation that must be provided for in another classification.
quotes: Net depreciation required to be provided for in any one classification shall not be reduced on account of net appreciation in any other classification.

claims.text: The Senior Management of the NBFC is responsible for implementing the fraud risk management policy approved by the Board.
quotes: The Senior Management shall be responsible for implementation of the fraud risk management policy approved by the Board of the Applicable NBFC.

claims.text: Senior Management must also place a periodic review of incidents of fraud before the Board or the Audit Committee of the Board, as appropriate.
quotes: The Senior Management of the Applicable NBFC shall also place a periodic review of incidents of fraud before Board / Audit Committee of Board (ACB), as appropriate.

claims.text: A regional rural bank must, in respect of all business transacted by it, prepare a balance sheet and profit and loss account as on the last working day of the year or the period, in the Forms set out in the Third Schedule of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949, as required by Section 29 of that Act.
quotes: In terms of the provisions of Section 29 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 (BR Act, 1949), a bank shall in respect of all business transacted by it prepare a balance sheet and profit and loss account as on the last working day of the year or the period, as the case may be, in the Forms set out in the Third Schedule of the BR Act, 1949.
These Directions shall be applicable to all Regional Rural Banks

claims.text: These Forms were specified by the Government of India under Section 29(4) of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 through notification S.O.240(E) dated March 26, 1992, and are reproduced in Annex I to the Directions.
quotes: In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 29(4) of the BR Act, 1949, the Government of India has specified the Forms in the Third Schedule, vide notification S.O.240(E) dated March 26, 1992
These are reproduced in Annex I to these Directions.

claims.text: The profit and loss account format is Form B under the Third Schedule.
quotes: the format of the profit and loss accounts of a bank prescribed in Form B under Third Schedule to the BR Act, 1949

claims.text: The bank must also follow the general instructions for compiling the balance sheet and profit and loss account, and must strictly comply with the Accounting Standards notified under the Companies (Accounting Standards) Rules, 2021, subject to RBI Directions and Guidelines.
quotes: A bank shall follow the general instructions for the compilation of balance sheet and profit and loss account

A bank shall ensure strict compliance with the Accounting Standards notified under the Companies (Accounting Standards) Rules, 2021, as amended from time to time, subject to Directions / Guidelines issued by the RBI.

claims.text: As a general rule, an NBFC in the Base Layer must take dividend income on shares of corporate bodies and units of mutual funds into account on a cash basis.
quotes: Income from dividend on shares of corporate bodies and units of mutual funds shall be taken into account on cash basis.

claims.text: Dividend income on shares of corporate bodies may instead be recognised on an accrual basis when the corporate body has declared the dividend at its annual general meeting and the NBFC's right to receive payment has been established.
quotes: the income from dividend on shares of corporate bodies shall be taken into account on accrual basis when such dividend has been declared by the corporate body in its annual general meeting and the NBFC’s right to receive payment is established.

claims.text: Where a company has obtained a specific advice from RBI that it is not required to hold a Certificate of Registration, the auditor must include a statement that the company is complying with the conditions stipulated by RBI.
quotes: where a company has obtained a specific advice from RBI that it is not required to hold a CoR from RBI, the auditor shall include a statement that the company is complying with the conditions as stipulated by RBI

claims.text: This statement is in addition to the matters set out in Paragraph 6(1), under which the auditor examines whether a company engaged in the business of a non-banking financial institution has obtained a Certificate of Registration from RBI.
quotes: Apart from the matters enumerated in Paragraph 6(1) above
the auditor of the NBFC shall examine whether the company has obtained a CoR from RBI

claims.text: A commercial bank must follow a 'secure by design' approach in developing digital payment products and services, making digital payment applications inherently more secure by embedding security within their development lifecycle.
quotes: The bank shall follow a ‘secure by design’ approach in the development of digital payment products and services.
ensure that digital payment applications are inherently more secure by embedding security within their development lifecycle

claims.text: The bank must explicitly define security objectives, including protection of customer information/data, across the requirements gathering, designing, development, testing (including source code review), implementation, maintenance and monitoring, and decommissioning phases of digital payment applications.
quotes: The bank shall explicitly define security objectives (including protection of customer information / data) during
requirements gathering
designing
development
testing including source code review
implementation, maintenance, and monitoring
decommissioning phases of the digital payment applications

claims.text: The bank must implement a multi-tier application architecture that segregates the application, database and presentation layers in its digital payment products and services.
quotes: The bank shall implement multi-tier application architecture, segregating application, database and presentation layer in the digital payment products and services.

claims.text: The bank's Board-approved policy for digital payment products must cover assurance that the payment product is built securely and rolled out after the testing needed to achieve the desired Functionality, Security and Performance.
quotes: formulate a policy for digital payment products and services with the approval of its Board
assurance that the payment product is built in a secure manner offering robust performance ensuring safety, consistency, and rolled out after necessary testing for achieving desired FSP

claims.text: The policy must also require each digital payment product to provide for User Acceptance Tests in multiple stages before roll-out and sign-off from multiple stakeholders after those tests.
quotes: mechanism for carrying out User Acceptance Tests (UAT) in multiple stages before roll-out, sign off from multiple stakeholders [post User Acceptance Tests (UAT)]

claims.text: When a stressed loan is transferred to an ARC at a price below the net book value at the time of transfer, the bank must debit the shortfall to the profit and loss account for the year in which the transfer took place.
quotes: When the stressed loan is transferred to ARC at a price below the NBV at the time of transfer, bank shall debit the shortfall to the profit and loss account for the year in which the transfer has taken place.

claims.text: The bank is permitted to use countercyclical or floating provisions to meet any such shortfall.
quotes: A bank is permitted to use countercyclical or floating provisions for meeting any shortfall on transfer of stressed loan when the transfer is at a price below the NBV.

claims.text: Yes. A small finance bank must report to credit information companies the details of guarantors who have failed to honour their commitments when the guarantee is invoked, as large defaulters or wilful defaulters, as the case may be.
quotes: A bank shall report to credit information companies the details of guarantors who have failed to honour the commitments thereunder when invoked, as large defaulters / wilful defaulters, as the case may be.

claims.text: The details of such guarantors must be reported as per Annex I and II.
quotes: The details shall be reported as per Annex I and II.

claims.text: A guarantor who refuses to comply with the bank's demand is also to be considered for classification as a wilful defaulter, following the mechanism in Paragraphs 5 and 6.
quotes: In case the said guarantor refuses to comply with the demand made by the bank, such guarantor shall also be considered for classification as a wilful defaulter by following the mechanism as set out in Paragraphs 5 and 6.

claims.text: The reporting bank is responsible for reporting correct information and for ensuring the accuracy of facts and figures.
quotes: The responsibility for reporting correct information and also ensuring the accuracy of facts and figures rests with the reporting bank.

claims.text: For the first 5 per cent of the book value of the loans securitised, the originator must hold the MRR through the first loss facility, if available.
quotes: Up to 5 per cent of the book value of loans being securitised:
First loss facility, if available;

claims.text: If no first loss facility is available, or the entire first loss facility comes to less than 5 per cent, the balance must be held by retaining the equity tranche.
quotes: If first loss facility is not available, or where retention of the entire first loss facility amounts to less than 5 per cent, balance through retention of equity tranche;

claims.text: If the first loss facility and equity tranche together come to less than 5 per cent, the balance must be held pari passu in the remaining tranches sold to investors.
quotes: Where retention of the entire first loss facility, if available, and equity tranche amounts to less than 5 per cent, balance pari passu in remaining tranches sold to investors.

claims.text: Retention above 5 per cent of the book value may be held in the first loss facility, the equity tranche or any other tranche sold to investors, in any combination.
quotes: Greater than 5 per cent of the book value of loans being securitised:
First loss facility, or equity tranche or any other tranche sold to investors, in any combination thereof.

claims.text: Overcollateralisation does not count as part of the first loss facility for this purpose.
quotes: first loss facility for this purpose shall not include overcollateralization available, if any.

claims.text: Investment in the Interest Only Strip representing the Excess Interest Spread or Future Margin Income does not count towards the MRR.
quotes: Investment in the Interest Only Strip representing the Excess Interest Spread/ Future Margin Income, whether or not subordinated, will not be counted towards the MRR.

claims.text: The originating bank must hold the MRR itself, not through any of its group entities, and the form of the MRR must not change during the life of the securitisation.
quotes: MRR has to be maintained by the originating bank itself and not by any of its group entities. The form of MRR should not change during the life of securitisation.

claims.text: The MRR must not be reduced by hedging the credit risk, or by selling or encumbering the retained interest.
quotes: MRR should not be reduced either through hedging of credit risk or selling or encumbering the retained interest.

claims.text: The MRR, as a percentage of unamortised principal, must be kept on an ongoing basis. The only reductions allowed are those from repayment or from absorbing losses.
quotes: The MRR as a percentage of unamortised principal should be maintained on an ongoing basis except for reduction of retained exposure due to repayment or through the absorption of losses.

claims.text: For securitisations with a replenishment period, the MRR must be maintained both at initiation and at the end of the replenishment period.
quotes: MRR should be maintained not only at the initiation of the securitisation but also at the end of the replenishment period.

claims.text: The bank must ensure there is proper documentation, in accordance with law, for complying with the MRR.
quotes: bank should ensure that proper documentation in accordance with law is made.

claims.text: Responsibility for redressing customers' grievances about outsourced services rests with the bank, and its grievance redressal mechanism must not be compromised in any manner because of the outsourcing.
quotes: A bank shall have a robust grievance redressal mechanism that shall not be compromised in any manner on account of outsourcing, i.e., responsibility for redressal of customers’ grievances related to outsourced services shall rest with the bank.

claims.text: For microfinance loans, the bank must declare that it is accountable for inappropriate behaviour by the service provider's employees and that it will provide timely grievance redressal.
quotes: In case of microfinance loans, a declaration that, (i) the bank shall be accountable for inappropriate behaviour of the employees of the service provider and (ii) shall provide timely grievance redressal

claims.text: This declaration must appear in the loan agreement and in the Fair Practices Code displayed at the bank's office, at its branch premises and on its website.
quotes: shall be made in the loan agreement, and in Fair Practices Code (FPC) displayed in its office, branch premises, and its website

claims.text: Outsourcing does not affect customers' rights against the bank, including their ability to obtain redressal under the relevant laws.
quotes: Outsourcing arrangements entered into by a bank shall not affect the rights of its customers against the bank, including the ability of the customers to obtain redressal as applicable under relevant laws.

claims.text: The bank must clearly state that its Grievance Redressal Machinery will also handle issues relating to services provided by the service provider.
quotes: It shall be clearly indicated that bank’s Grievance Redressal Machinery will also deal with the issue relating to services provided by the service provider

claims.text: The bank's designated grievance redressal officer must ensure that genuine customer grievances are redressed promptly.
quotes: The designated officer shall ensure that genuine grievances of customers are redressed promptly without involving delay.

claims.text: A complainant may seek redressal under the RBI's Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2021 in three cases: if the bank wholly or partly rejects the complaint, if the complainant is not satisfied with the reply, or if no reply is received within 30 days.
quotes: If a complaint is rejected wholly or partly by a bank, and the complainant is not satisfied with the reply, or does not get any reply within 30 days after the bank received the complaint, the complainant shall have the option to seek grievance redressal under the RBI’s Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2021.

claims.text: In addition to directly notifying customers, the UCB must publicise the benefits of the nomination facility through various media, including periodical drives aimed at full coverage of all eligible customer accounts.
quotes: in addition to directly notifying the customers, shall publicise the benefits of using the nomination facility through various media, including launching periodical drives towards achieving a full coverage of all eligible customer accounts

claims.text: The UCB must give wide publicity and guidance on the benefits of nomination to deposit account holders, locker hirers and depositors of articles in safe custody; this may include printing messages on cheque books, passbooks and other customer literature and launching periodical awareness drives.
quotes: A UCB shall give wide publicity and provide guidance to deposit account holders, locker hirers and depositors of articles in safe custody on the benefits of the nomination facility.
printing compatible messages on cheque book, passbook and other literature reaching the customers as well as launching periodical awareness drives

claims.text: Forms for opening deposit accounts, hiring lockers and depositing articles in safe custody must contain a space for nomination details, which also educates customers that the facility is available.
quotes: contains a space for getting the details of nomination, which also serves the purpose of educating the customers about availability of such facility

claims.text: At account opening, the UCB must explicitly inform prospective customers of the availability and purpose of nomination, offer the option, and clearly explain its advantages, such as a simpler claim process and smooth transfer of funds to the nominee.
quotes: shall explicitly inform the prospective customer of the availability and purpose of the nomination facility and offer her / him the option to avail the same
simplification of the claim process in the event of the account holder’s demise and facilitation of smooth and prompt transfer of funds to the nominee without legal complications

claims.text: The UCB must sensitise its frontline branch staff on obtaining nominations.
quotes: The UCB shall suitably sensitise its frontline staff in the branches for obtaining nomination

claims.text: A small finance bank must provide its internal audit department with appropriate resources and staff to achieve its objectives under the risk-based internal audit system.
quotes: The bank shall provide appropriate resources and staff to the IAD to achieve its objectives under the RBIA system.

claims.text: The bank must ensure that its internal audit function has the requisite skills to audit all areas of the bank.
quotes: The bank shall ensure that its Internal Audit function has the requisite skills to audit all areas of the bank.

claims.text: Internal auditors should be trained periodically so they understand the bank's business activities, operating procedures, risk management and control systems, and MIS.
quotes: They should also be trained periodically to enable them to understand the bank’s business activities, operating procedures, risk management and control systems, and Management Information System (MIS).

claims.text: The internal audit department should be given an appropriate standing within the bank to carry out its assignments.
quotes: should be given an appropriate standing within a bank to carry out its assignments

claims.text: The internal audit function should be kept informed of all developments, including the introduction of new products, changes in reporting lines, and changes in accounting practices or policies.
quotes: The Internal Audit function should be kept informed of all developments, including introduction of new products, changes in reporting lines, and changes in accounting practices / policies.

claims.text: A commercial bank must invoke a default loss guarantee within a maximum overdue period of 120 days, unless the borrower makes good the loan dues before that.
quotes: A bank shall invoke DLG within a maximum overdue period of 120 days, unless the loan dues are made good by the borrower before that.

claims.text: The DLG agreement must remain in force for a period not less than the longest tenor of the loan in the underlying loan portfolio.
quotes: The period for which the DLG agreement remains in force shall not be less than the longest tenor of the loan in the underlying loan portfolio.

claims.text: The contract between the bank and the DLG provider must specify the timeline for DLG invocation.
quotes: Timeline for DLG invocation.

claims.text: A UCB must maintain an up-to-date information asset inventory register, and the fields listed are a minimum requirement.
quotes: The UCB shall maintain an up-to-date information asset inventory register containing the following fields, as a minimum:

claims.text: The register must contain details of the information asset, such as hardware, software, network devices, key personnel and services.
quotes: details of the information asset (such as hardware / software / network devices, key personnel, services)

claims.text: The register must contain details of the systems where customer data are stored.
quotes: details of systems where customer data are stored

claims.text: The register must contain the associated business applications, if any.
quotes: associated business applications, if any

claims.text: The register must record the criticality of the systems, for example high, medium or low.
quotes: criticality of the systems (for example, high / medium / low)

claims.text: A small finance bank's Board must fulfil four major roles: overseeing the bank's risk profile, monitoring the integrity of its business and control mechanisms, ensuring expert management, and maximising the interests of its stakeholders.
quotes: A bank’s Board shall fulfil four major roles viz. overseeing the risk profile of the bank, monitoring the integrity of its business and control mechanisms, ensuring the expert management, and maximising the interests of its stakeholders.

claims.text: The Board must set and enforce clear lines of responsibility and accountability for itself, senior management and the whole organisation.
quotes: set and enforce clear lines of responsibility and accountability for itself as well as the senior management and throughout the organization

claims.text: The Board must pay specific attention to creating and sustaining a culture of control.
quotes: The Board shall specifically pay attention to creating and sustaining a culture of control.

claims.text: The Board must maintain oversight of the bank's risk management system, policy and strategy, its exposures to related entities, and its conformity with corporate governance standards.
quotes: risk management system, policy and strategy followed by the bank
exposures to related entities of the bank
conformity with corporate governance standards

claims.text: The Board must ensure that directors' responsibilities are well-defined and that every director is familiarised with the bank's functioning before induction.
quotes: ensure that responsibilities of its directors are well-defined, and every director is familiarised with the functioning of the bank before their induction

claims.text: The Board is responsible for approving policies and for risk governance in respect of the various activities the bank undertakes.
quotes: responsible for approval of policies and risk governance in respect of various activities undertaken by the bank

claims.text: For projects where financial closure was achieved as on October 1, 2025, any resolution of a fresh credit event and/or change in material terms and conditions in the loan contract on or after October 1, 2025, is governed by the guidelines in paragraphs 101 to 119 of the Resolution of Stressed Assets Directions.
quotes: any resolution of a fresh credit event and/or change in material terms and conditions in the loan contract in such projects, on or after October 1, 2025, shall be as per the guidelines contained in paragraphs 101 to 119.
projects where financial closure has been achieved as on October 1, 2025

claims.text: In such a resolution, the provisioning provisions of paragraph 115 apply to these projects as if they were sanctioned on or after October 1, 2025.
quotes: in case of any resolution of a fresh credit event and / or change in material terms and conditions in the loan contract in such projects, the provisions stipulated in paragraph 115 shall apply to these projects as if these were sanctioned on or after October 1, 2025.

claims.text: Under these guidelines, the AIFI must monitor the project's performance and any buildup of stress on an ongoing basis and is expected to initiate a resolution plan well in advance.
quotes: An AIFI shall monitor the performance of the project and any buildup of stress on an ongoing basis and shall be expected to initiate a resolution plan well in advance.

claims.text: Provisioning for project loans classified as standard or NPA is as per the Income Recognition, Asset Classification and Provisioning Directions.
quotes: Provisioning for project loans classified as ‘standard’ (construction or operational phase) or NPA shall be as per extant instructions contained in the Reserve Bank of India (All India Financial Institutions – Income Recognition, Asset Classification and Provisioning) Directions, 2025.

claims.text: An ARC must classify a non-performing asset as a loss asset if it has been non-performing for a period exceeding 36 months.
quotes: 'Loss asset' if-
the asset is non-performing for a period exceeding 36 months

claims.text: It must also be classified as a loss asset if it is adversely affected by a potential threat of non-recoverability due to erosion in the value of security or non-availability of security.
quotes: the asset is adversely affected by a potential threat of non-recoverability due to either erosion in the value of security or non-availability of security

claims.text: It must be classified as a loss asset if it has been identified as a loss asset by the ARC or its internal or external auditor.
quotes: the asset has been identified as a loss asset by the ARC or its internal or external auditor

claims.text: It must be classified as a loss asset if the financial asset, including security receipts, is not realised within the total time frame in the ARC's realisation plan under paragraph 36 and the ARC or trust continues to hold it.
quotes: the financial asset including SRs is not realized within the total time frame specified in the plan for realisation formulated by the ARC under paragraph 36 and the ARC or the trust concerned continues to hold those assets

claims.text: Under paragraph 36, the realisation period must not exceed five years from acquisition, though the Board may extend the total period to no more than eight years from acquisition.
quotes: the period for realisation shall not exceed five years from the date of acquisition of the financial asset concerned
the total period for realisation shall not exceed eight years from the date of acquisition of the financial asset concerned

claims.text: A loss asset must be written off entirely; if it is retained in the books, 100 percent provision is required.
quotes: The entire asset shall be written off
If, for any reason, the asset is retained in the books, 100 percent thereof shall be provided for

claims.text: The reporting ARC is responsible for reporting correct information and for ensuring the accuracy of the facts and figures.
quotes: The responsibility for reporting correct information and also ensuring the accuracy of facts and figures rests with the reporting ARC.

claims.text: When furnishing information to credit information companies, the ARC must ensure the accuracy of the directors' particulars, wherever possible by cross-checking them with the database maintained by the Registrar of Companies.
quotes: An ARC, while furnishing information to credit information companies, shall ensure the accuracy of the particulars of the directors, and wherever possible, by cross-checking with the database maintained by the Registrar of Companies.

claims.text: A credit information company must periodically review the financial and operational condition of each service provider to assess whether it can continue to meet its obligations, and it must use a risk-based approach to set how often these reviews happen.
quotes: A CIC shall periodically review the financial and operational condition of the service provider to assess its ability to continue to meet its obligations.
A CIC shall adopt risk-based approach in defining the periodicity.

claims.text: These due diligence reviews must highlight any deterioration or breach in performance standards, confidentiality, security and operational resilience preparedness.
quotes: Such due diligence reviews shall highlight any deterioration or breach in performance standards, confidentiality, security, and operational resilience preparedness.

claims.text: Separately, the company must conduct regular audits of its service providers, including sub-contractors, and the frequency of those audits is set by the nature and extent of the risk and the impact of the outsourcing arrangement on the company.
quotes: A CIC shall conduct regular audits
of service providers (including sub-contractors)
The frequency of the audit shall be determined based on the nature and extent of risk, and impact on the CIC from the outsourcing arrangements.

claims.text: Senior Management must review reports on monitoring and control activities periodically, and any adverse development must be put up to the Board for information.
quotes: Reports on the monitoring and control activities shall be reviewed periodically by the Senior Management, and in case of any adverse development, the same shall be put up to the Board for information.

claims.text: A mortgage guarantee company must classify its assets, loans and advances and any other forms of credit into four classes: standard assets, sub-standard assets, doubtful assets and loss assets.
quotes: classify its assets, loans and advances and any other forms of credit into the following classes, namely:
(1) Standard assets;
(2) Sub-standard assets;
(3) Doubtful assets; and
(4) Loss assets

claims.text: The classification is made after taking into account the degree of well defined credit weaknesses and the extent of dependence on collateral security for realisation.
quotes: after taking into account the degree of well defined credit weaknesses and extent of dependence on collateral security for realisation

claims.text: Assets acquired under guarantee obligations are not to be classified as standard assets.
quotes: Assets acquired under guarantee obligations will not be classified as standard assets.

claims.text: An asset's class is not to be upgraded merely because of rescheduling, unless it satisfies the conditions the Reserve Bank stipulates for upgradation.
quotes: shall not be upgraded merely as a result of rescheduling, unless it satisfies the conditions as stipulated by the Reserve Bank from time to time

claims.text: A housing finance company must record on the face of fixed deposit receipts (and RD passbooks) whether the nomination facility has been availed, using the legend "Nomination Registered".
quotes: The HFC shall introduce the practice of recording on the face of the RD passbooks/ FDRs the position regarding availment of nomination facility with the legend “Nomination Registered”

claims.text: It must also indicate the name of the nominee on the fixed deposit receipt, if the customer agrees to this.
quotes: they shall also indicate the name of the Nominee in the RD passbook/ FDRs, in case the customer is agreeable to the same

claims.text: A payments bank's net cumulative negative mismatches in the domestic Structural Liquidity Statement must not exceed 5 per cent of cumulative cash outflows in the next-day bucket, 10 per cent in the 2-7 days bucket, 15 per cent in the 8-14 days bucket, and 20 per cent in the 15-30 days bucket.
quotes: The net cumulative negative mismatches in the domestic SLS (Refer Annex-I - Part A1 Liquidity Return) during the next day, 2-7 days, 8-14 days, and 15-30 days bucket shall not exceed 5 per cent, 10 per cent, 15 per cent, and 20 per cent of the cumulative cash outflows in the respective time bucket.

claims.text: The bank must also adopt the same cumulative mismatch limits for its Structural Liquidity Statement covering consolidated bank operations.
quotes: A bank shall also adopt the above cumulative mismatch limits for its SLS for consolidated bank operations (Annex-I – Part B).

claims.text: The main focus is on short-term mismatches up to 30 days, and the bank must also monitor cumulative mismatches across all time buckets by setting internal prudential limits approved by the Board or the Risk Management Committee.
quotes: the main focus shall be on the short-term mismatches, i.e., up to 30 days
A bank shall also monitor cumulative mismatches across all time buckets by setting internal prudential limits, with the approval of the Board or the RMC.

claims.text: For critical information systems and/or those in the DMZ having a customer interface, vulnerability assessment must be conducted at least once every six months and penetration testing at least once in 12 months.
quotes: For critical information systems and / or those in the DMZ having customer interface, VA shall be conducted at least once in every six months and PT at least once in 12 months.

claims.text: For non-critical information systems, the bank must use a risk-based approach to decide whether and how often to conduct vulnerability assessment and penetration testing.
quotes: For non-critical information systems, a risk-based approach shall be adopted to decide the requirement and periodicity of conduct of VA / PT.

claims.text: Vulnerability assessment and penetration testing of critical, internet-facing applications, servers and network components must also be done throughout their lifecycle, including pre-implementation, post-implementation and after changes.
quotes: periodically conduct VA / PT of critical, internet facing web / mobile applications, servers, and network components throughout their lifecycle including pre-implementation, post-implementation, and after changes

quotes: a drawn tranche of the contingent PCE facility shall be required to be repaid within 30 days from the date of its drawal (due date)

claims.text: The facility is treated as an NPA if it remains outstanding for 90 days or more from the due date, and it is provided for under the usual asset classification and provisioning norms.
quotes: The facility shall be treated as NPA if it remains outstanding for 90 days or more from the due date and provided for as per the usual asset classification and provisioning norms.

claims.text: When that happens, the AIFI's other facilities to the borrower are also classified as NPA under extant guidelines.
quotes: In that event, the AIFIs’ other facilities to the borrower shall also be classified as NPA as per extant guidelines.

claims.text: The short repayment period applies because a credit enhancement is drawn only when there is a cash flow shortfall for servicing a debt or bond, which indicates that the project is in financial distress.
quotes: Credit Enhancement (CE) gets drawn only in a contingent situation of cash flow shortfall for servicing a debt / bond etc.
such an event is indicative of financial distress of the project

claims.text: Yes. The chief compliance officer of a small finance bank must not be more than 55 years of age at the time of appointment.
quotes: The CCO shall not be more than 55 years of age at the time of appointment.

claims.text: There is an exception: a person above 55 who has had continuous association with the Compliance function, whether as chief compliance officer or otherwise, can have the 55-year age limit applied as of the date that continuous association started.
quotes: if a person identified as CCO is above the age of 55 years, but had continuous association with the Compliance function either as CCO or otherwise, the age limit of 55 years may be taken as the date from when the continuous association with the Compliance function started for the identified CCO

quotes: if a person identified for CCO role is more than 55 years old but has been continuously associated with the Compliance function prior to completing the age of 55 years, she/ he would be eligible for such appointment

claims.text: For a rating to be eligible for risk weighting, the rating agency should have reviewed it at least once during the previous 15 months.
quotes: The rating agency should have reviewed the rating at least once during the previous 15 months.

claims.text: The rating must also be in force and confirmed from the monthly bulletin of the rating agency concerned.

claims.text: The UCB must give wide publicity and guidance on the benefits of nomination to deposit account holders, locker hirers and depositors of articles in safe custody; this may include printing messages on cheque books, passbooks and other customer literature and launching periodical awareness drives.
quotes: A UCB shall give wide publicity and provide guidance to deposit account holders, locker hirers and depositors of articles in safe custody on the benefits of the nomination facility.
printing compatible messages on cheque book, passbook and other literature reaching the customers as well as launching periodical awareness drives

claims.text: Forms for opening deposit accounts, hiring lockers and depositing articles in safe custody must contain a space for nomination details, which also educates customers that the facility is available.

simplification of the claim process in the event of the account holder’s demise and facilitation of smooth and prompt transfer of funds to the nominee without legal complications

claims.text: Internal auditors should be trained periodically so they understand the bank's business activities, operating procedures, risk management and control systems, and MIS.

claims.text: The internal audit department should be given an appropriate standing within the bank to carry out its assignments.

claims.text: The internal audit function should be kept informed of all developments, including the introduction of new products, changes in reporting lines, and changes in accounting practices or policies.
quotes: The Internal Audit function should be kept informed of all developments, including introduction of new products, changes in reporting lines, and changes in accounting practices / policies.

quotes: A bank shall invoke DLG within a maximum overdue period of 120 days, unless the loan dues are made good by the borrower before that.

claims.text: The DLG agreement must remain in force for a period not less than the longest tenor of the loan in the underlying loan portfolio.
quotes: The period for which the DLG agreement remains in force shall not be less than the longest tenor of the loan in the underlying loan portfolio.

claims.text: The contract between the bank and the DLG provider must specify the timeline for DLG invocation.
quotes: Timeline for DLG invocation.

claims.text: A UCB must maintain an up-to-date information asset inventory register, and the fields listed are a minimum requirement.
